verdict.rationale: Kong's gateway source is publicly hosted in the official GitHub repo Kong/kong, so its source is clearly readable. A separate official repo, go-kong, refers to an 'OSS' edition of Kong Gateway, which implies an open-source core. However, no evidence item states which license covers the code, and the pack also shows Enterprise and Konnect components whose openness is undocumented. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license for the Kong repo, clarity on which parts (OSS vs Enterprise/Konnect) are openly licensed, independent corroboration.
